ABOUT THE JOB

A place to work.
Room to learn.

If you’re sick of working weird hours and weekends, or just looking for more opportunities, this could be the shop for you. We strive for a personable, non-intimidating environment for not only customers, but employees as well.

This is a busy shop, working on most makes and models. To help us keep up with the ever changing automotive industry, continuing education is always paid for and encouraged, for all employees.

What we’re looking for

  • Full time positions
  • Pay determined on experience and skills
  • Certifications are preferred either from manufacturers, ASE, or other training institutions
  • Willingness to learn and good team skills are a must!
